$comment: Declarative overlay for the DSH profile variant `im-test`.
The image installs the connector under /opt/dsh-im and the admin wrapper in the default
template; this manifest is merged into a fresh copy of that template by
dataops_dsh_service.py when a workspace starts with DATAOPS_DSH_PROFILE=im-test and
DATAOPS_DSH_PROFILE_VARIANT=im-test. It adds the connector package link the wrapper's
connector mode imports and pins that package's version; it adds no bundle row of its own.
`@sparkelf/dsh-dataops-im` applies `@xmanrui/dsh-im` itself in connector mode, so the
variant must NOT also mount the connector as a separate bundle: a second apply would
register the same tools twice. The default 25-row bundle list is the whole list.
`dshImVersion` is the single pin for the experiment; the image build installs exactly
that version, fails when npm resolves another one, and includes the installed package
manifest in the variant marker so a version bump re-assembles existing volumes.
name: im-test
